title: Broadcast one value
summary: Broadcasting lets some differently shaped values work together. A single number can be used for every item in an array.
introduction: Broadcasting lets some differently shaped values work together. A single number can be used for every item in an array. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Broadcasting lets some differently shaped values work together. A single number can be used for every item in an array.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np

scores = np.array([2, 4, 6])
print((scores + 1).tolist())
blocks.title: Broadcast one value

blocks.text: The output is [3, 5, 7]. NumPy adds 1 at each position.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Not every pair of shapes can broadcast; their dimensions must follow NumPy's rules.
For more detail later, use this [NumPy further reading](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/user/absolute_beginners.html).
